text:
The trial court should rule the deposition testimony **admissible as former testimony**. The engineer is unavailable, and FRE 804(b)(1) requires only that the party against whom the testimony is offered (the company) had an opportunity and similar motive to examine the witness. The company's attorney took the deposition in the wrongful termination suit, and the company had the same motive to challenge the claim that its safety reports were false. The pilot's absence from that first suit doesn't matter, because the rule looks to the opposing party.

CONFIDENCE: 82
